doc.sousTitre: Tonnage, records, all-time PRs: the exact rule, with worked examples.

tonnage.definition: For each set held: reps × load. Then the sum over the sets.
tonnage.ex1Piege: Not 1,125 kg: the product of the averages (2 × 7.5 × 75) is not the sum of the products as soon as the load varies. The gap is 10 %, and it does not show — the averages look right and the total is low.
tonnage.realise: What was done beats what was prescribed. A load or reps you entered replace the plan; otherwise the plan counts.
tonnage.fourchette: A range counts at its lower bound: “8/10” is 8.
tonnage.sansCharge: A line with no load, or measured in seconds, has NO tonnage — which is not the same as a tonnage of zero. It stays in tracking without weighing.

series.sansEchec: With no failure recorded, every prescribed set counts — even if you only filled in the RPE of one of them.
series.avecEchec: As soon as a FAIL appears in the per-set detail, only the FILLED, non-FAIL cells count. An empty cell next to a failure no longer counts.
series.ex3Piege: A single cell reads as set 1, never as “the last one”. If nothing is filled in, nothing was done.
series.pasUnFiltre: This is not a filter: the line stays in tracking with zero sets, and keeps its load, its RPE and its record of failure. It is the volume that is zero, not the session that disappears.

records.serieePasLigne: A record is a property of a SET, not of a line. Ten then twelve reps at 40 kg do not make a record at eleven.
records.sansDetail: With no per-set detail, the line gives a single candidate, with its reps and its load — what was done if entered, otherwise what was prescribed.
records.avecDetail: With per-set detail (reps or load), each position gives its own candidate, with ITS reps and ITS load. Positions marked FAIL do not compete.
records.retenu: A candidate is only kept between 1 and 10 reps, with a load above zero, and at a date already past. The best is kept per movement / rep-count pair.
records.ex2Piege: The detail beats the overall value, including when it is harsher.

allTime.aLaMain: They are entered by hand by the staff, never computed. They do not move on their own when a session is saved.
allTime.identite: Their identity is the full tuple: movement, sets, reps, variant, format.
allTime.pasLeRM: Not to be confused with the programming 1RM (the RM table), which is the basis for increment percentages — that is another value, editable, and it is not a record.

horsCompte.titre: What does not enter the charts
horsCompte.echauffement: Lines marked “warm-up” and “rehab” are excluded from the aggregates. A line with no mark counts as training.
horsCompte.secondes: Reps measured in seconds are not added to reps: a plank does not inflate your volume.
horsCompte.variante: Tracking groups by movement NAME ONLY. The variant enters neither the filter nor the group: “BENCH PRESS” with a barbell and with dumbbells end up on the same curve.
